lens: mTOR's therapeutic manipulation presents a Janus-faced dilemma: its inhibition bolsters waning immunity in the elderly yet may inadvertently fuel metastatic pathways in cancer, demanding a precision approach that current systemic treatments fail to provide.
known_to_ignore: mTOR pathway regulates cell growth and metabolism
mTOR inhibitors are used as immunosuppressants and anticancer agents
mTOR hyperactivation is common in various cancers
tensions: RAD001 improves influenza vaccine response in elderly humans (2014) vs. mTOR hypomorphism causing 40% mortality in mice (2013), highlighting immune dependency
Torin2's potent mTOR inhibition (EC50 250 pmol/L) but off-target effects on DNA-PK, ATR, ATM (2013), complicating therapeutic specificity
mTOR hyperactivation in 70% of urothelial carcinomas (2022) vs. mTOR pathway activation linked to liver metastasis in breast cancer (2017), suggesting organ-specific roles
gaps: Lack of studies on mTOR inhibitor dosing regimens optimized for immune enhancement in aged cancer patients
Underexplored combination of mTOR inhibitors with DNA repair-targeting agents based on off-target effects
Limited data on mTOR modulation in neurological disorders like epilepsy with NPRL3 variants

theses.title: Contextual mTOR Modulation: Age and Tissue-Specific Therapeutic Windows for Immune and Cancer Applications
theses.rationale: Synthesizes disparate findings on mTOR's roles in aging immunity and cancer metastasis to propose a precision framework for geriatric oncology, leveraging high-impact studies like the RAD001 vaccine trial from Science Translational Medicine (2014).

reviewer_objections: The proposed therapeutic windows are inferred from non-overlapping studies; direct evidence in elderly cancer patients is needed.
Scoping reviews may lack the depth of systematic reviews or meta-analyses, potentially limiting impact.
next_extractions: Human trials of mTOR inhibitors in combination with cancer immunotherapy in patients over 65
Preclinical models testing Torin2 analogs with improved selectivity for mTOR vs. DNA repair kinases
Clinical data on mTOR pathway activity in age-stratified cancer metastasis cohorts
